placements.why: Quinton Fairweather announces a strategic shift from Zypherion to Meridian for the analytics pipeline due to critical gaps in Zypherion's streaming ingestion and Meridian's native batch and streaming support, while retaining the Q3 2026 rollout window.
placements.title: Transitioning Analytics Pipeline to Meridian for Unified Batch and Streaming Ingestion
placements.frame: What architectural capabilities and ingestion requirements justify switching the analytics pipeline database to Meridian?
